name: dsh-workbench
description: Self-contained workbench for deepseek-harness: governed workflow runs with approvals, artifacts, evidence, and a react-flow visual editor.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @workflow-platform/workbench-governance && npm run build:client --workspace @workflow-platform/workbench-ui
scripts.pack:plugins: npm run pack:plugin --workspace @workflow-platform/workbench-governance && npm run pack:plugin --workspace @workflow-platform/workbench-ui
